reading: Joined by the terms: Zid's Abandoned Carts / السلات المتروكة, its Merchant API folder Abandoned Carts (ZD-S-0006) and staff permission manage.store.abandonedcarts, إدارة السلات المتروكة (ZD-S-0474), are Salla's Abandoned Carts / السلات المتروكة, its Merchant API folder of that name (SA-S-1035) and its permission إدارة السلات المتروكة (SA-S-2570). Strained: its Zid Alerts statements, 'خاصية تنبيهات زد مفعلة تلقائيًا لمساعدتك في استهداف السلات المتروكة' (ZD-S-1018) and their WhatsApp messages from Zid's number (ZD-S-1019), are cited in domain D's CM-MKT-022 (abandoned cart recovery) by D-zid, another tree, and left there by the rule One thing, one domain.

Joined by the terms: Zid's checkout page settings, 'خيارات صفحة إتمام الشراء' reached from لوحة التحكم > الاعدادات (ZD-S-0961), and its API folder API's > Checkout (ZD-S-0049), are the checkout and its settings: Shopify's route checkout-settings (SH-S-5106) and Salla's dashboard link Checkout (SA-S-1685). A reading: Zid's إتمام الشراء is its word for checkout, as its own English folder name Checkout shows. Its Get Cart operation (ZD-S-0049) is also cited in CM-CHK-002, a child of CM-CHK-001, so the fit stays in one tree. Which options the page holds isn't stated beyond Zid Assurance (ZD-S-0996, domain A); Q1's gap on its decides placement is 'observation needed'.

Joined by the terms: Zid's Custom Fields / حقول مخصصة, 'إضافة معلومات إضافية لمنتجاتك أو طلباتك' (ZD-S-0963), in the settings page خصائص الطلبات والمنتجات (ZD-S-0962) with its orders tab (ZD-I-0138), are Salla's custom fields for orders, Custom fields at /orders/custom-fields (SA-S-1780) and the plan line إضافة حقول مخصصة للطلبات (SA-S-2131). Neither platform says the buyer fills them in at checkout: that rests on the capability's name, as in Salla's cell. Strained: the concern also holds product properties. Its plan line ZD-S-0963 is cited as core in domain E's CM-CNT-002 by E-zid, and the 30-minute hold of a product in the cart (ZD-S-0965) as core in domain B's CM-INV-008 by B-zid, both other trees; its product API List Product Settings (ZD-S-0964) is cited nowhere here, since it shows products, not orders (notes).

Joined on role, a reading: Zid's official working hours, 'يمكنك التحكم بأوقات العمل و إغلاق المتجر بشكل كلي مؤقتاً' at الاعدادات > المتجر > أوقات العمل الرسمية (ZD-S-0970), set when the store works, the role of Salla's Ordering hours (SA-S-1738) and its plan line تعيين أوقات استقبال الطلبات (SA-S-1991). Zid doesn't say its working hours govern when orders are received, and no Zid statement defines them; Q1's gaps on its decides and boundary placements are 'observation needed' and 'searched, not found'. Strained: the same statement's temporary closing of the store is cited as core in domain A's CM-ACC-007 (Maintenance mode) by A-zid, another tree.

Joined by the terms: Zid's Orders / الطلبات, its Merchant API folder Orders (ZD-S-0004) and webhook topic order.create (ZD-S-0057), are Salla's Orders, its Merchant API folder Orders (SA-S-1016) and event order.created (SA-S-1582). The concern holds the orders as a whole, so it lands in the parent; its editing, statuses, drafts, tags and notes are cited in CM-ORD-002, 003, 005, 011 and 013, its children. Its plan line Bulk Export Orders (ZD-I-0263), an inventory entry, is cited in domain G's CM-MIG-001 by G-zid. Its statements on shipping companies setting a status and being told an order is ready (ZD-S-1010, ZD-S-1011) are cited in CM-ORD-003 here; batch 4 may cite ZD-S-1011 in SHP, still under domain C.

A new capability only Zid shows so far: the order's payment status, with its own webhook topic order.payment_status.update, 'Triggered when an order's payment status changes to paid or unpaid' (ZD-S-0722), and its own plan lines Payment Status / حالة الدفع (ZD-S-0723) and Bulk Payment Status Update (ZD-S-0724). Searched every domain (caps: payment status; حالة الدفع; financial status; paid; unpaid): CM-ORD-003 holds the order's stages and CM-PAY-020 its payment transactions, neither the paid or unpaid state (capability note).

Moved to domain D, by the rule One thing, one domain: Zid Voice is abandoned cart recovery, 'Recover abandoned carts with a voice agent' (ZD-S-0452), 'Available now for abandoned cart recovery · Limited pilot' (ZD-S-1069), which is domain D's CM-MKT-022 (Abandoned cart and order recovery), whose Zid cell, written by D-zid, already cites ZD-S-0452 (core) and ZD-S-1069 (shows). scope.tsv names D under also. Its other statements, the place الطلبات > زد فويس (ZD-S-1067), 100 free calls (ZD-S-1068), an AI that calls on the merchant's behalf (ZD-S-1070), choosing customers from the abandoned carts or a file (ZD-S-1071) and its reason (ZD-S-1072), are left to that cell. No statement names Zid's company as Zid Voice's maker, and Q1's gap says which company provides the voice agent wasn't found.
